title: Local or member
prompt: The starter has a member `score` at 0, but `add_points` creates its own local `score` instead of using the member, so solve still returns 0. Fix add_points so it changes the member, and solve(10) returns 10.
hints: Writing var inside a function makes a new, separate variable with the same name.
Remove var so the line changes the member.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A variable at the top of the script (a member variable): every function in the script can read and change it.
